Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Interface CPDFSignatureContainerProvider

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface CPDFSignatureContainerProvider
Supplies a complete detached CMS/PKCS#7 SignedData container for a prepared PDF.

The provider owns service authentication, transport timeouts and retries, certificate selection, signed attributes and any embedded signature timestamp. AWS KMS Sign returns only a raw signature; a service using KMS must also assemble the complete container. The SDK does not require AWS credentials for this callback.

  • Method Details

    • signContainer

      CPDFSignatureContainerResult signContainer(CPDFSignatureContainerRequest request) throws Exception
      Builds the container for this request's PDF digest.

      Called synchronously on the thread invoking CPDFExternalSignatureSigner.signWithContainer(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFSignatureOptions, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFSignatureContainerProvider), at most once after preparation succeeds. A new signing attempt has a new digest; do not reuse an earlier container. The SDK does not impose a timeout or retry the callback. A provider shared across simultaneous signing calls must handle concurrent invocation itself.

      Parameters:
      request - the immutable digest and actual signature-field name; never null
      Returns:
      complete DER SignedData on success, or an explicit service failure; null is treated as sdk.container.result_missing
      Throws:
      Exception - if the service call fails; converted to sdk.container.provider_exception without exposing exception text; Java Error instances propagate to the caller
